maximum_depth_rule: All 59 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements remain raw maximum-depth records until policy hierarchy, indicator definition, baseline, current value, target value, period, unit, population, and annotations can be separated through reviewed field-level evidence.
version_boundary: The fiscal 2026 policy collection is retained as its own official version. Earlier priority-issue evaluations and other fiscal-year materials are not attached automatically as annual actuals for the current policy collection.
non_goals: Do not split mixed policy-table statements into inferred annual actual and target fields.
Do not merge national averages, reference values, baselines, current values, and targets automatically.
Do not replace missing units, populations, periods, or hierarchy levels by inference.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
